hook: A massive $5 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC is barreling toward a high-stakes trial.

sections.voiceover: A massive $5 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC is barreling toward a high-stakes trial.
But can the BBC avoid trial over a Panorama edit of a Trump January 2021 speech?
However, Judge Jeffrey T. Kuntz just denied the BBC's bid to throw out the case.
The BBC lodged an urgent appeal with the US Court of Appeals on November 25, 2026. Donald Trump initially sought $10 billion in damages before reducing the claim to $5 billion.
Judges at the 11th Circuit now hold the power to decide this massive legal battle.
